def analyze(g,label):
    print('====',label)
    cs=comps(g)
    for comp in cs:
        i0=min(i for i,j in comp); j0=min(j for i,j in comp)
        shape=frozenset((i-i0,j-j0) for i,j in comp)
        n9=frozenset((i-i0,j-j0) for i,j in comp if g[i][j]==9)
        print('at',(i0,j0),'h,w',max(i for i,j in comp)-i0+1,max(j for i,j in comp)-j0+1,'shape',sorted(shape),'9s',sorted(n9))
    # check if any block's 9s == another's shape (or subset)
    for a in cs:
        for b in cs:
            if a is b: continue
            ia=min(i for i,j in a); ja=min(j for i,j in a)

            if n9a and (n9a==shapeb or n9a<=shapeb):
